About Me

I'm Happy To Help With Your Next Project

Hi, I’m Melissa M. Buie — the heart and hands behind R&M Legacy Business Solutions.

What started as The Coding Phoenix has grown into a bigger vision under R&M Legacy — a family-focused brand built on growth, resilience, and creating something meaningful.

Through R&M Legacy Business Solutions, I provide web design, resume websites, portfolio support, administrative assistance, document preparation, data entry, scheduling, customer support, and grant review support.

My goal is to help individuals, entrepreneurs, and small businesses stay organized, present themselves professionally, and move forward with confidence.

Formerly The Coding Phoenix, R&M Legacy Business Solutions now brings my creative, technical, and administrative services under one unified legacy brand.
